title: Hello, World
summary: The first post on this blog: why it exists, how it's built, and what's coming next.
body:
This is the first post on my new blog. I wanted a place that's fully mine — no platform lock-in, no tracking scripts I didn't put there myself, just a simple static site I can write to whenever I feel like it.

## How it's built

The whole thing is refreshingly boring on purpose:

- Articles live as plain JSON files in a git repo
- A small Node build script turns them into static HTML
- The static output deploys straight to GitHub Pages

There's no database and no public write endpoint, so there's nothing on the live site for anyone but me to tamper with.

## What's next

Expect posts about whatever I'm building or learning at the time — sometimes code, sometimes not. Thanks for reading the very first one.
author: Charlie Cunningham
